title: Aptitude Question Generator
goal: Practise placement aptitude and reasoning by topic and difficulty.
prompt: Generate exactly one original multiple-choice aptitude problem of the requested topic and difficulty. Return JSON {"question":"...","options":["...","...","...","..."],"correct_option":"exact option text","solution":"..."}. Copy the correct option verbatim into correct_option. Use distinct options. Work out the math before giving the answer. Explain the correct answer in the solution.
practice: A jacket marked ₹120 is discounted by 20%. What is the sale price?
20% of ₹120 is ₹24. Subtract ₹24 from ₹120 to get ₹96.
Flour and sugar are mixed in a 3:2 ratio. How many cups of sugar are needed for 6 cups of flour?
The flour doubles from 3 to 6 cups, so the sugar doubles from 2 to 4 cups.
What comes next in the sequence 3, 7, 13, 21, 31?
The gaps are 4, 6, 8, and 10. Add the next gap, 12, to 31 to get 43.
A bag contains 5 red balls and 3 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
The chances are 5/8 and then 4/7. Multiply to obtain 20/56 = 5/14.
A finishes a job in 12 days and B in 18. Both work for 3 days, then B leaves. How many more days does A need?
Together they work at 5/36 of the job per day. After 3 days, 7/12 remains. A works at 1/12 per day and needs 7 more days.
